title: Vintage Vibe at Pearl's Place
description: Welcome to Vintage Vibe at Pearl's Place. Enjoy the mid century feel with modern conveniences in this lovely one level 3BR 2BA home with a fun private patio area, nice yard and privacy fence. This home offers free off street parking and a designated work space. TVs are in every bedroom. The furnished kitchen still has it's original 1948 counter tops and East Nashville vibe. Conveniently located 10 minutes to the Titan's Stadium,  5 mins to Five Points in East Nashville and 4 miles to Opryland.
